Job title: Wealth Transformation Graduate
Department: Wealth Transformation, Wealth Management
Salary: £45,000
Start date: Thursday 16 September 2027
Location: City of London, London
About Schroders, our parent company
Schroders is a global investment manager which provides active asset management, wealth management and investment solutions. We aim to provide excellent investment performance to clients through active management. We serve a diverse client base that includes pension schemes, insurance companies, sovereign wealth funds, endowments, foundations, high net worth individuals, family offices, as well as end clients through partnerships with distributors, financial advisers, and online platforms.
Established in 1804, we have around 5,500 people across 36 global locations. Schroders' success can be attributed to its diversified business model, spanning different asset classes, client types and geographies.
Programme overview:
Our two-year Wealth Transformation Graduate Programme offers a unique opportunity to gain broad experience across Business Transformation at one of the UKs leading & fastest growing wealth management business. You’ll combine on-the-job experience with structured learning and development, including taking the Investment Advisory Diploma (IAD), and opportunities to network with colleagues across the business.
As part of the programme, you will undertake rotations within Wealth Transformation, gaining hands-on experience in the roles of Business Architecture, Strategic design, Business Analysis and Project Management
Through these rotations, you will gain exposure to strategic design opportunities spanning the Wealth business, including Client teams, Investment, Operations and key support functions.
Who we are looking for
A strong interest in the transformation of a business to improve growth, efficiency and risk outcomes
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to express ideas clearly and work effectively with a range of colleagues.
Collaborative and relationship-oriented, building trusted connections within teams and across the organisation.
Inquisitive and commercially aware, with a genuine interest in Wealth Management and relevant industry trends.
Innovative, analytical and able to apply critical thinking by thinking ‘outside the box’ and applying a fresh perspective, particularly using AI.
Proactive, organised, and eager to get involved in a broad range of tasks, projects, and teams.
Adaptable and resilient, able to manage multiple priorities, remain composed during periods of uncertainty, and embrace new challenges.
A self-starter with a strong sense of ownership and accountability, a high attention to detail who takes the initiative and delivers high-quality work.
A growth mindset - we understand you may make mistakes, and when you do, we are looking for you to learn from these.
Eager to learn and develop, actively embracing feedback, pursuing professional growth, and demonstrating natural curiosity.
Problem solver with the ability to ‘get into the detail’ whilst seeing and managing the ‘bigger picture’.
The Team
Schroders Wealth Transformation team has a remit across the transformation lifecycle from strategy to execution. We collaborate with our business and technology partners across the Schroders Group to enable our Cazenove Capital and Schroders International Wealth business to thrive in an increasingly competitive, regulated and margin pressured global landscape by shaping, mobilising and delivering both transformational and essential change to allow the business to grow profitably while providing high levels of investment performance and client experience.
What you will do
Throughout the programme, you will take an active role in a broad range of transformation projects and initiatives. You will gain exposure to and experience in the key Change roles of Business Architect, Project Manager and Business Analyst, with hands-on experience within each discipline. You will have the opportunity to contribute at all stages of the Change lifecycle, from strategy and design, to project delivery and implementation.
Project Management:   Collaborate with project teams and business stakeholders to drive the successful delivery of change initiatives on time and within budget. Establish a critical path and deliverable plan, ensuring clarity of direction, effective communication, and disciplined project governance throughout each phase.
Business Analysis: Act as a bridge between business needs and solutions, working collaboratively with stakeholders to understand and articulate requirements, define target processes, and support the design and realisation of effective, value-driven change.
Business Architect : Contributing as a proactive team member, building knowledge of the business, strategic design, and operating model, to support the design and delivery of successful transformation projects to help solve business challenges and create sustainable value for the organisation.
Qualifications required:
An honours degree or equivalent – we are open to all degree subjects and predicted grades
You will be in your final year of study or have already graduated
No prior Change or Wealth Management experience is need. We just need you to bring your drive, passion and enthusiasm to make the most of the opportunity, to start building your career.
Benefits of joining us :
When you join the Wealth Transformation Graduate programme at Schroders, you will benefit from a wide range of professional and personal development opportunities, including:
Professional qualifications:
Achieve the Investment Advice Diploma (IAD) in your first few weeks - the UK’s benchmark entry qualification for investment professionals
Opportunity to complete further qualifications related to your role
Comprehensive training:
Access immersive training sessions covering industry knowledge, technical skills, and essential soft skills to help you adapt, thrive, and make an impact from day one
Senior networking opportunities:
Attend exclusive “Coffee Hours” hosted by senior leaders, allowing you to build your network within the industry
Buddy system:
Be paired with a dedicated buddy to support your transition into both the programme and the wider business
Wellbeing support:
Access to our Employee Assistance Programme, offering 24-hour confidential counselling and resources on a range of topics, including mental health
Use of a private GP service
On-site facilities:
Enjoy the convenience of an on-site staff restaurant and complimentary use of our on-site gym
By joining us, you will be part of an inclusive environment where your learning, wellbeing, and professional growth are a priority.
Recruitment process:
Online application form
Stage 1 Cognitive Online Assessment
Stage 2 Behavioural and Motivational Assessment 
Stage 3 Work Simulation and Video Interview 
Assessment centre 
Candidates should be available to start the Wealth Transformation Graduate programme on Thursday 16 September 2027.
We Recognise Potential, Whoever You Are
Our purpose is to deliver excellent investment performance to clients through active management. We believe diverse perspectives and an inclusive culture help us make better decisions and achieve better outcomes for our clients. That's why inclusion is a strategic priority for us, and we are an equal opportunities employer. You are welcome here, regardless of your age, disability, gender identity, religious beliefs, sexual orientation, socio-economic background, or any other protected characteristic.
We will consider flexible working arrangements for all roles and provide reasonable accommodations to support applicants and employees, including those with neurodiversity, disability, or physical and mental health needs. For more information, please visit our FAQs.

2518.text:
Job title: Wealth Transformation Intern
Department: Wealth Transformation, Wealth Management
Salary: £37,000 pro-rated over the course of the internship
Start date: Monday 14 June 2027
Location: City of London, London
About Schroders, our parent company
Schroders is a global investment manager which provides active asset management, wealth management and investment solutions. We aim to provide excellent investment performance to clients through active management. We serve a diverse client base that includes pension schemes, insurance companies, sovereign wealth funds, endowments, foundations, high net worth individuals, family offices, as well as end clients through partnerships with distributors, financial advisers, and online platforms.
Established in 1804, we have around 5,500 people across 36 global locations. Schroders' success can be attributed to its diversified business model, spanning different asset classes, client types and geographies.
Programme overview:
Our 2027 Summer Internship Programme runs for 10 weeks and is designed to give you a unique introduction to the wealth management industry. It offers valuable insight into how Wealth Transformation operates within one of the UK’s leading and fastest growing wealth management businesses.
Throughout the programme you will:
Take part in introductory training to build your understanding of the business
Be assigned to a team in Wealth Transformation, where you will contribute to live projects and gain hands-on experience
Shadow experienced professionals and learn directly from people working across the Wealth business
Have opportunities to network with colleagues and other interns, helping you build connections for your future career
This internship provides practical experience, skill development and a strong foundation for those interested in a career in wealth management and business transformation.
Who we are looking for
An inquisitive and motivated individual who is eager to learn, develop and explore new ideas, with an interest in how a business is transformed to improve growth, efficiency and risk outcomes
A collaborative team player who builds trusted relationships and contributes positively to team success
A self-starter who takes initiative, embraces responsibility and is keen to get involved in a broad range of activities
Someone with a growth mindset who actively seeks feedback and learns from experience – we understand you may make mistakes, and when you do, we want you to learn from them
An adaptable and resilient individual who stays composed when managing competing priorities and embraces new challenges with a positive attitude
Required skills & capabilities
Good communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to express ideas clearly and work well with a range of colleagues
Analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to balance attention to detail with the bigger picture and bring a fresh perspective to new challenges
Good organisational skills, with the ability to manage multiple tasks and adapt to changing circumstances
A proactive approach, with a willingness to take ownership of tasks and see them through
Curiosity and a genuine interest in wealth management, industry trends, change and emerging technologies, including AI
The Team
Schroders Wealth Transformation team has a remit across the transformation lifecycle from strategy to execution. We collaborate with our business and technology partners across the Schroders Group to enable our Cazenove Capital and Schroders International Wealth business to thrive in an increasingly competitive, regulated and margin pressured global landscape by shaping, mobilising and delivering both transformational and essential change to allow the business to grow profitably while providing high levels of investment performance and client experience.
What you will do
During your 10-week internship, you will be assigned to a live project in the role of either Business Analyst, Project Manager or Business Architect. Depending on your placement, your experience may include:
Project Manager:   Collaborate with project teams and business stakeholders to gain exposure to the delivery of change initiatives. Support the team by assisting with project coordination, planning, communications and documentation, while learning about effective project management practices. Help keep project activities organised and tracked, and take part in regular meetings and governance processes.
Business Analyst: Gain exposure to how business analysis bridges business needs and solutions by working alongside analysts and stakeholders. You may help gather and articulate business requirements, assist with documenting processes, and support the preparation of materials used in designing and implementing change.
Business Architect : Contribute as a proactive team member while building knowledge of the business, strategic design and operating model. You may support the design and delivery of transformation projects that help solve business challenges and create sustainable value for the organisation.
You will also own the delivery of an internally focused project, to deliver a pre-defined outcome that helps solve a business challenge or creates specific sustainable value for the organisation.
Knowledge, experience and qualifications we’re looking for:
When the internship commences, you will have completed your second year of studies and be on track to graduate with a degree (or equivalent) in 2028 – we are open to all degree subjects
Please note that we do not accept applications from students in their final year who intend to undertake further study (e.g. a Master’s degree) before entering employment
A good working knowledge of document production software, including Microsoft Word, Excel and PowerPoint
The ability to understand our target audiences
No prior Change or Wealth Management experience is needed. We just need you to bring your drive, passion and enthusiasm to make the most of the opportunity, to start building your career.
Benefits of joining us :
When you join our Wealth Transformation internship programme at Schroders, you will benefit from a wide range of professional and personal development opportunities, including:
Comprehensive training:
Access training sessions covering industry knowledge, technical skills and essential soft skills to help you settle in quickly and make a meaningful contribution
Senior networking opportunities:
Attend exclusive “Coffee Hours” hosted by senior leaders, allowing you to build your network within the industry
Buddy system:
Be paired with a dedicated graduate buddy who will guide and support your integration into the team and wider business
Potential for future opportunities:
The chance to secure a place on a 2028 Schroders Graduate Programme, subject to performance feedback
End-of-programme event:
Celebrate your achievements alongside other interns and line managers at a dedicated event at Schroders HQ
Wellbeing support:
Access to our Employee Assistance Programme, offering 24-hour confidential counselling and resources on a range of topics, including mental health
Use of a private GP service
On-site facilities:
Enjoy the convenience of an on-site staff restaurant and complimentary use of our on-site gym
By joining us, you will be part of an inclusive environment where your learning, wellbeing, and professional growth are a priority.
Recruitment process:
Online application form
Stage 1 Cognitive Online Assessment
Stage 2 Behavioural and Motivational Assessment 
Stage 3 Work Simulation and Video Interview 
Assessment centre 
Candidates should be available to start the internship programme on Monday 17 June 2027 until Friday 20 August 2027.
We Recognise Potential, Whoever You Are
Our purpose is to deliver excellent investment performance to clients through active management. We believe diverse perspectives and an inclusive culture help us make better decisions and achieve better outcomes for our clients. That's why inclusion is a strategic priority for us, and we are an equal opportunities employer. You are welcome here, regardless of your age, disability, gender identity, religious beliefs, sexual orientation, socio-economic background, or any other protected characteristic.
We will consider flexible working arrangements for all roles and provide reasonable accommodations to support applicants and employees, including those with neurodiversity, disability, or physical and mental health needs. For more information, please visit our FAQs.

2521.text:
Job title: Graduate Trainee Department: Finance, Wealth Management Salary: £45,000 Start date: Thursday 16 September 2027
Location: City of London, London
About Us
Schroders is a global investment manager which provides active asset management, wealth management and investment solutions. We aim to provide excellent investment performance to clients through active management. We serve a diverse client base that includes pension schemes, insurance companies, sovereign wealth funds, endowments, foundations, high net worth individuals, family offices, as well as end clients through partnerships with distributors, financial advisers, and online platforms.
Established in 1804, we have around 5,500 people across 36 global locations. Schroders' success can be attributed to its diversified business model, spanning different asset classes, client types and geographies.
Why Finance:
Finance at Schroders is about much more than numbers. It gives you a unique view of how a global wealth manager operates – from financial control to partnering with senior leaders to drive strategic, commercial decision making. As a Finance graduate, you’ll work with teams that help the business make informed decisions, manage risk, and deliver sustainable growth.
This graduate programme is best suited to candidates who are genuinely interested in building a career in Finance. While you’ll gain exposure to the wider asset management industry, the role is not an investment management or client-facing programme.
Programme overview:
The Schroders Graduate programme is two years long. However, we provide an additional third year of rotations in Finance to support your professional qualification journey and give you broader, practical experience across the function. The programme is designed to help you develop the technical skills, business understanding and professional judgement needed to build a long-term career in Finance.
During the Graduate programme, you may support work across financial planning and analysis, finance operations, regulatory reporting, control activities and business partnering. This could include analysing financial information, preparing presentations, supporting reporting processes, improving ways of working, and collaborating with colleagues across Finance and the wider business.
Who we’re looking for:
We’re looking for proactive, curious and motivated graduates who are excited by the opportunity to understand how Finance supports a global investment management business. You’ll enjoy working with numbers, asking thoughtful questions, building relationships across teams and communicating your ideas clearly. We value people who take ownership, are willing to get stuck in and challenge the status quo and bring enthusiasm and energy to new challenges.
Our Finance Graduate programme is the perfect start for a graduate looking to become a qualified accountant and build their long-term career in Finance.
Strong analytical skills and confidence working with numerical information
Broader business awareness and a basic understanding of how the asset management industry operates
Curiosity about how businesses operate and how Finance supports decision-making
Clear verbal and written communication skills
Proactive approach, with a willingness to take ownership and follow through
Ability to build relationships and work collaboratively with different teams
Good attention to detail and commitment to producing high-quality work
Comfortable using Excel, PowerPoint and Word, with willingness to develop technical and AI skills further
Interested in developing a long-term career in Finance and completing either the ACCA or CIMA qualification
The team:
Our Finance function is central to delivering the firm’s strategic objectives and driving sustainable, profitable growth. The team provides vital financial insights, supports well-informed decision-making, and ensures strong financial and regulatory control.
The Finance department’s core focus areas are:
Supporting sound commercial decisions through insightful analysis and business partnering
Enabling effective business operations with efficient finance processes
Safeguarding the organisation with robust financial and regulatory controls
Our activities span three key pillars: Financial Planning & Analysis (FP&A), Operations, and Control, delivered through finance hubs in the UK and Horsham, as well as local teams in other regions.
Knowledge, experience and qualifications we’re looking for:
You should be due to graduate in 2027, or have recently graduated, and be on track to achieve, or have already achieved, an honours degree (or equivalent). We welcome applications from all degree subjects.
Maths A-level or equivalent is preferable (a STEM degree if you do not hold a Maths A-level or equivalent) but not essential
A good working knowledge of document production software, including Microsoft Word, Excel, and PowerPoint
If you are commercially aware, analytical, and ready to thrive in a dynamic environment, we look forward to hearing from you.
Benefits of joining us :
When you join our graduate programme at Schroders, you will benefit from a wide range of professional and personal development opportunities, including:
Professional qualifications:
achieve the Investment Management Certificate (IMC) in your first few weeks - the UK’s benchmark entry qualification for investment professionals
Finance Graduates are expected to take study for either the ACCA or CIMA qualification after the IMC, with the expectation that exams are completed within three years. Support will be provided through study leave and a key point of contact for the three years.
Comprehensive training:
access immersive training sessions covering industry knowledge, technical skills, and essential soft skills to help you adapt, thrive, and make an impact from day one
Senior networking opportunities:
attend exclusive “Coffee Hours” hosted by senior leaders, allowing you to build your network within the industry
Buddy system:
be paired with a dedicated buddy to support your transition into both the programme and the wider business
Wellbeing support:
access to our Employee Assistance Programme, offering 24-hour confidential counselling and resources on a range of topics, including mental health
Use of a private GP service
On-site facilities:
enjoy the convenience of an on-site staff restaurant and complimentary use of our on-site gym
By joining us, you will be part of an inclusive environment where your learning, wellbeing, and professional growth are a priority.
Recruitment process:
Online application form
Stage 1 Cognitive Online Assessment
Stage 2 Behavioural and Motivational Assessment
Stage 3 Work Simulation and Video Interview
Assessment centre
Candidates should be available to start the graduate programme on Thursday 16 September 2027.
We Recognise Potential, Whoever You Are
Our purpose is to deliver excellent investment performance to clients through active management. We believe diverse perspectives and an inclusive culture help us make better decisions and achieve better outcomes for our clients. That's why inclusion is a strategic priority for us, and we are an equal opportunities employer. You are welcome here, regardless of your age, disability, gender identity, religious beliefs, sexual orientation, socio-economic background, or any other protected characteristic.
We will consider flexible working arrangements for all roles and provide reasonable accommodations to support applicants and employees, including those with neurodiversity, disability, or physical and mental health needs. For more information, please visit our FAQs.
